description: This file defines the 'DocumentsParseRule' class, which extends 'BaseRule' and implements parsing rules for document-related panels within the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods for pre-processing panel data to replace certain identifiers with field names and for sanitizing panel data during parsing.

classes.name: DocumentsParseRule
classes.description: A class that applies specific parsing rules to document panels in the SuiteCRM application's UI, modifying panel data according to custom matching patterns.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Iterates through panels and replaces specific column identifiers with corresponding field names based on predefined rules, considering the view context.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Sanitizes panel data during parsing by clearing values that match specific document-related patterns.
